summary: Print-only defects fixed in this commit: Page 1 Item 9 Registered Address no longer hard-clips (removed hardcoded 7.3px override so bir-print dynamic fitting fits the full address), Item 11 'If yes, specify' now prints 'SPECIAL RATE' / 'INTERNATIONAL TAX TREATY' via derived:special_tax_specify in to_print_field_map() + writer-cells.json (to_bir_field_map() / upload XML unchanged), Header Item 3 ('10') and Item 2/11 checkboxes now render cleanly, and Page 2 Schedules 4 & 5 rows right-align at uniform font size. Remaining open defect 2550M-P2 (computed 12% VAT boxes 13B, 18F, 18H, 18J, 18L, 18O printing 0.00 because Form2550MDraft::recompute() never multiplies bases by 0.12) is intentionally deferred to its own computation commit. Earlier 2550M-S1 was corrected to a test-tooling fault (see form-review/TOOLING.md): a real taxpayer can add Schedule 2-8 rows on screen.

defects.description: Correction: a real taxpayer can complete Schedule 2-8 rows in the UI drawer (Date Purchased / cell-0 renders visually on screen). Automated capture failed only because gpui-agent snapshot --refs omits cell-0 inside the drawer scroll and form.fill refuses editor-owned schedule keys (documented in form-review/TOOLING.md).

Part I Item 9 Registered Address previously shrank to ~5pt and hard-clipped '...METRO MAN' at the right border due to hardcoded #p1c20-i{font-size:7.3px !important} in print-overrides/2550m-2007.css. Removing that rule lets bir-print dynamic sizing fit the entire address cleanly without clipping.

Part II computed VAT output/input tax boxes 13B, 18F, 18H, 18J, 18L, and 18O all display and print 0.00 for non-zero bases because Form2550MDraft::recompute() never multiplies by 0.12 (deferred to the separate 2550M computation commit).

Part I Item 11 'If yes, specify' previously printed blank because frm2550m:lstSpecialTax holds an option code ('1'/'2'). Added Form2550MDraft::to_print_field_map() emitting derived:special_tax_specify ('SPECIAL RATE' / 'INTERNATIONAL TAX TREATY') and joined it to p1c23 in html-frozen/2550m-2007/writer-cells.json; to_bir_field_map() and upload XML are unchanged.

Header Item 3 Number of Sheets Attached ('10') previously rendered microscopic/clipped due to hardcoded #p1c3-i0/#p1c3-i1 font-size:3px !important in print-overrides/2550m-2007.css, and Item 2/11 checkboxes were tiny/off-center. Removed the #p1c3-i0/#p1c3-i1 overrides and centered #p1c4-i,#p1c5-i,#p1c24-i,#p1c25-i with flex 6.5pt.
Page 2 Schedule 4 and Schedule 5 right-hand amount cells (#p2c219-i, #p2c225-i, #p2c81-i) now right-align at uniform 8.5pt matching their sibling rows.
Official BIR Form 2550M PDF has 4 pages (Pages 3-4 are Guidelines/Instructions); the app renders 2 form pages.
